Remove placeholder animals added for unknown parents

Source: R/removeUnknownAnimals.R
removeUnknownAnimals.Rd

Remove placeholder animals added for unknown parents

Usage

removeUnknownAnimals(ped)

Arguments

ped

The pedigree information in data.frame format

Value

Pedigree with the animals whose recordStatus is "added" removed. Every other animal is kept, including one whose recordStatus is missing (NA) or has any other value. A pedigree without a recordStatus column has no animals marked as added, so it is returned unchanged.

Examples

ped <- data.frame(
  id = c("o1", "o2"),
  sire = c("s1", "s1"),
  dam = c("d1", "d1"),
  sex = c("F", "M"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
## addParents() adds records for the parents s1 and d1, marked "added"
withParents <- addParents(ped)
withParents
#>   id sire  dam sex recordStatus
#> 1 o1   s1   d1   F     original
#> 2 o2   s1   d1   M     original
#> 3 s1 <NA> <NA>   M        added
#> 4 d1 <NA> <NA>   F        added
removeUnknownAnimals(withParents)
#>   id sire dam sex recordStatus
#> 1 o1   s1  d1   F     original
#> 2 o2   s1  d1   M     original
